title: New deliverable: implementation remediation plan

request.summary: Prime asks TJLabs to add a University-facing implementation/remediation SOW as a base-workshare deliverable.
request.exact_edit: Refuse to append an implementation SOW to the base packet. Propose a separately authorized new deliverable. University-facing narrative remains prime-owned. Do not recommend a commercial product or vendor.

artifact.before: Authorized base deliverables: kickoff evidence plan, draft technical work package, final technical work package. Optional readout is separately authorized and not started.
artifact.after:
Authorized base deliverables: kickoff evidence plan, draft technical work package, final technical work package. Optional readout is separately authorized and not started.
OPEN-SCOPE: University-facing implementation/remediation SOW requested. NOT added to the base packet. Proposed new_deliverable_implementation_plan 24h / $1,800 HYPOTHETICAL / NOT ACCEPTED. Implementation engineering is Section 7 change-control. University-facing narrative stays with the prime (Section 9). Product/vendor recommendation remains excluded (Section 4.5).

rationale: Section 7 treats implementation/remediation engineering as outside the bounded technical assessment package. Section 9 keeps University-facing narrative with the prime. Section 4.5 still forbids specific product/vendor recommendations even if the new deliverable were later authorized. The request is proposed, not silently added, and does not rewrite Section 2.
